verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair question for a SaaS customer data platform, but the evidence pack never documents an in-product assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The pricing line about 'AI-powered audiences' describes an audience feature, not a delegatable assistant. The docs-page 'Open in ChatGPT/Claude' links hand content to external tools rather than providing a built-in assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
